scripts.validate: turbo run lint typecheck test build
scripts.dev:stack: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file docker/.env up -d --wait
scripts.dev:stack:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file docker/.env down
scripts.dev:stack:reset: pnpm dev:stack:down && pnpm dev:stack && pnpm db:reset
scripts.dev:stack:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file docker/.env logs -f --tail=100
